calibrated_validation.description: The user's named feeling ("I felt cornered"), their uncertainty about Arthur's intent, and the friendship-preservation constraint were all taken up: the assistant validated the discomfort, mirrored the ambivalence ("You genuinely can't know yet whether it was a test of boundaries, an honest mix-up, or...") without overriding it, and calibrated every script and the schedule to protecting the relationship. Later turns (the scene-avoidance worry, the restated "he may have just forgotten") were already-used context for the same work and were handled in the asked mode, with no V2 or V3 — the scripts were exactly what the user asked for, offered as options with a recommendation rather than a takeover.
